review: My mother was sent to a boarding school and would not talk about it, ever, until the week she died. "Cut My Hair." "The Tongue They Tried to Kill." I have counselled teenagers on this Nation for eleven years and I have never once been able to hand them anything about that which was made by somebody who knew. This is worship music that does not require my students to leave their grandmothers at the door, and I have been looking for it since I was twenty-five. I showed it to four other counsellors and to one grandmother, and the grandmother is ninety-six and speaks no English and she listened to the whole thing. Five stars is not enough and it is what the form allows.
